scope: same-subject prospective online validation; not cross-subject or physical-latency validation

admission.preferred: all five candidate CH2/3/4/5/7 are finite, nonconstant, non-rail, and continuous
admission.formalMinimum: at least three of five candidate channels pass the pre-session quality gate
admission.scientificWording: this is a predeclared engineering admission rule, not a three-channel sufficiency, validation, or equivalence claim
admission.fail: two or fewer usable candidates, or any frozen selected channel later fails

channelSanity.selectionPolicy: pre-plan quality-driven selection from candidates, then frozen for session; no outcome-driven selection

preflight: ND8 ready at 1000 Hz with 8xN callback packets

pilot.bugPolicy: a correctness bug aborts pilot; repair requires a fresh pilot and formal session

formalPlan.randomization: deterministic recorded seed; maximum two identical targets consecutively
formalPlan.groundTruth: generated before EEG and unavailable to live decoder

requirements: report planned, invalid, and replacement history

midSessionElectrodeFailure: PAUSE immediately; if any frozen channel fails, ABORT the formal session and retain it as incomplete evidence. Do not continue with four channels.

outcomes.latency: software-side logical decision latency relative to software stimulus start: first/final median, mean, p95, max

pause: single recoverable transport/sync warning before a trial; re-run preflight before continue

completion.scientificResult: accuracy is reported, not threshold-gated; a non-100% result is not an engineering failure

evidenceBoundary: no true physical end-to-end latency claim
